content.json:
# Insider Risk and Data Exfiltration

Three ways data leaves, one tab each. **Network** reads the firewall (`CommonSecurityLog`) for large
uploads from internal addresses to the internet. **Devices** reads Defender for Endpoint for USB
drives, files written to them, and transfer tools. **Cloud** reads Microsoft 365 activity for bulk
downloads and sharing links.

None of this proves intent. It shows who and what to ask about, and how much data is involved.

**Tables read:** `CommonSecurityLog`, `DeviceEvents`, `DeviceFileEvents`, `DeviceProcessEvents`, `DeviceNetworkEvents`, `CloudAppEvents`. A tile or chart for a table you do not collect shows an error; the rest still works.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
     | where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
     | summarize Value = round(sum(SentBytes) / 1073741824.0, 1)
     | extend Metric = "GB sent to the internet (firewall)", Position = 1),
    (DeviceEvents
     | where ActionType == "UsbDriveMounted"
     | summarize Value = todouble(count())
     | extend Metric = "USB drives mounted", Position = 2),
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where ActionType in~ ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull")
     | summarize Value = todouble(count())
     | extend Metric = "Files downloaded from SharePoint and OneDrive", Position = 3),
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where ActionType in~ ("AnonymousLinkCreated", "SharingInvitationCreated", "SecureLinkCreated", "CompanyLinkCreated",
                             "AddedToSecureLink")
     | summarize Value = todouble(count())
     | extend Metric = "Sharing links and invitations created", Position = 4)
| order by Position asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: In the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| summarize SentGB = round(sum(SentBytes) / 1073741824.0, 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Data sent from internal addresses to the internet (GB)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| summarize BytesSent = sum(SentBytes),
            BytesReceived = sum(ReceivedBytes),
            Destinations = dcount(DestinationIP),
            User = take_any(SourceUserName)
            by Source = SourceIP
| extend SentGB = round(BytesSent / 1073741824.0, 2),
         UploadRatio = round(todouble(BytesSent) / todouble(BytesReceived + 1), 1)
| project Source, User, SentGB, UploadRatio, Destinations
| top 25 by SentGB desc
content.title: Internal addresses that sent the most
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| summarize BytesSent = sum(SentBytes),
            Sources = dcount(SourceIP),
            Host = take_any(DestinationHostName),
            Ports = strcat_array(make_set(DestinationPort, 5), ", ")
            by Destination = DestinationIP
| extend SentGB = round(BytesSent / 1073741824.0, 2)
| project Destination, Host, SentGB, Sources, Ports
| top 25 by SentGB desc
content.title: Internet addresses that received the most
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "UsbDriveMounted"
| extend Usb = parse_json(tostring(AdditionalFields))
| summarize Mounts = count(), LastMounted = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Device = DeviceName, Drive = tostring(Usb.ProductName), Serial = tostring(Usb.SerialNumber)
| top 100 by Mounts desc
content.title: USB drives mounted
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let Mounts = DeviceEvents
    | where ActionType == "UsbDriveMounted"
    | extend DriveLetter = toupper(substring(tostring(parse_json(tostring(AdditionalFields)).DriveLetter), 0, 2))
    | where isnotempty(DriveLetter)
    | summarize MountedAt = min(TimeGenerated) by DeviceId, DriveLetter;
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| extend DriveLetter = toupper(substring(FolderPath, 0, 2))
| join kind=inner Mounts on DeviceId, DriveLetter
| where TimeGenerated >= MountedAt
| summarize Files = dcount(FolderPath),
            TotalMB = round(sum(FileSize) / 1048576.0, 1),
            Examples = strcat_array(make_set(FileName, 5), ", "),
            LastCopy = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName, Device = DeviceName
| top 50 by Files desc
content.title: Files written to removable media, by account
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let TransferTools = dynamic(["rclone.exe", "megasync.exe", "megacmd.exe", "megaclient.exe", "megacmdserver.exe",
                             "winscp.exe", "winscp.com", "pscp.exe", "psftp.exe", "filezilla.exe", "restic.exe",
                             "azcopy.exe", "gsutil.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where tolower(FileName) in (TransferTools) or tolower(ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName) in (TransferTools)
| summarize Executions = count(),
            Devices = dcount(DeviceId),
            Accounts = strcat_array(make_set(AccountName, 5), ", "),
            ExampleCommand = take_any(ProcessCommandLine),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Tool = tolower(FileName)
| order by Executions desc
content.title: Cloud copy and file transfer tools
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let SharingSites = dynamic(["mega.nz", "mega.co.nz", "dropbox.com", "wetransfer.com", "transfer.sh", "anonfiles.com",
                            "gofile.io", "pastebin.com", "file.io", "sendspace.com", "mediafire.com", "pcloud.com",
                            "box.com", "drive.google.com"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) and RemoteUrl has_any (SharingSites)
| summarize Connections = count(),
            Devices = dcount(DeviceId),
            Processes = strcat_array(make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5), ", "),
            Accounts = strcat_array(make_set(InitiatingProcessAccountName, 5), ", "),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Site = RemoteUrl
| top 50 by Connections desc
content.title: Connections to file sharing and paste sites
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in~ ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull")
| summarize Files = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Application
content.title: Files downloaded from SharePoint and OneDrive over time
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let Downloads = CloudAppEvents
    | where ActionType in~ ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull");
let Peaks = Downloads
    | summarize HourlyFiles = dcount(ObjectName) by AccountObjectId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | summarize BusiestHour = max(HourlyFiles) by AccountObjectId;
Downloads
| summarize Files = dcount(ObjectName),
            Sites = dcount(tostring(RawEventData.SiteUrl)),
            Countries = strcat_array(make_set(CountryCode, 5), ", "),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by AccountObjectId, Account = AccountDisplayName
| join kind=inner Peaks on AccountObjectId
| project Account, Files, BusiestHour, Sites, Countries, LastSeen
| top 50 by Files desc
content.title: Accounts that downloaded the most files
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in~ ("AnonymousLinkCreated", "SharingInvitationCreated", "SecureLinkCreated", "CompanyLinkCreated",
                        "AddedToSecureLink")
| summarize Shares = count(),
            AnonymousLinks = countif(ActionType =~ "AnonymousLinkCreated"),
            ExternalInvitations = countif(ActionType =~ "SharingInvitationCreated"),
            Items = dcount(ObjectName),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Account = AccountDisplayName
| top 50 by Shares desc
content.title: Sharing links and invitations, by account
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json: These are the detection rules in this repository for this area (`Detection-rules/` in SentinelWork). A rule with 0 alerts is either not deployed, not enabled, or has had nothing to report in the time range. Alerts are matched to rules by name, so a rule you rename in Sentinel stops being counted here. Incidents are matched by rule name or by the rule's identifier, so they survive a rename.

content.query:
let Rules = datatable(RuleId:string, AlertName:string, RuleSeverity:string, Tactics:string) [
    "EX-001", "Large outbound transfer to one external address", "Medium", "Exfiltration",
    "EX-002", "Many files copied to removable media", "Medium", "Exfiltration",
    "EX-003", "Mass download from SharePoint or OneDrive", "Medium", "Collection, Exfiltration",
    "EX-004", "Cloud copy or file transfer tool executed", "Medium", "Exfiltration"
];
let AlertCounts = SecurityAlert
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
    | summarize AlertCount = count(), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName;
Rules
| join kind=leftouter AlertCounts on AlertName
| project RuleId, Rule = AlertName, Severity = RuleSeverity, Tactics, Alerts = coalesce(AlertCount, 0), LastAlert
| order by RuleId asc
content.title: Rule coverage
content.noDataMessage: No rules are defined for this area.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Large outbound transfer to one external address", "Many files copied to removable media", "Mass download from SharePoint or OneDrive", "Cloud copy or file transfer tool executed"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AlertName
content.title: Alerts over time, by rule
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Large outbound transfer to one external address", "Many files copied to removable media", "Mass download from SharePoint or OneDrive", "Cloud copy or file transfer tool executed"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, Rule = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity, Status,
          Details = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]), Entities
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Latest alerts
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Large outbound transfer to one external address", "Many files copied to removable media", "Mass download from SharePoint or OneDrive", "Cloud copy or file transfer tool executed"]);
let RuleIds = dynamic(["6805bf8b-47c4-5553-a5be-c6e47c4bb2ca", "7f9301b9-112c-59f5-b790-994eadfedf83", "8c637be0-b121-5f68-a4c1-d99d0a10a160", "6f962748-3af3-5613-9780-4f03271f8bff"]);
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Title in (RuleNames) or tostring(RelatedAnalyticRuleIds) has_any (RuleIds)
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| project CreatedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification,
          AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          AgentDisposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText), IncidentUrl
| order by CreatedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Incidents created by these rules
content.noDataMessage: No incidents from these rules in the time range.
